title: done moves a claimed run key to landed also inside land and without --commit, and delivery_evidence runs one git merge-base per query-log commit
goal: cmd_done moves a claimed run key to landed only when done --commit made its commit and no land is running it (land's own cmd_done leaves the key to land's verify step, so a worker-less land whose push fails does not read landed), and delivery_evidence finds the bound's later query-log deliveries with one git call per bound instead of one merge-base call per KB-Auto commit. Found by the SP-yriisdti review (two S2 gaps and one S3 on BG-wcgmj4zu and BG-2naamm5z).

import json, os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = os.path.abspath("_tools"); root = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); S = os.path.join(root, "coord.sqlite")
env = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@e.x", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@e.x", KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def run(*a):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
git = lambda *a: run("git", *a)
bl = lambda *a: run(sys.executable, os.path.join(T, "backlog.py"), "--root", root, *a)
git("init", "-q", "-b", "main")
open(os.path.join(root, "backlog.json"), "w").write(json.dumps({"item_dir": "items", "lane_module": "", "land_push": ["git", "status"]}))
git("add", "-A"); git("commit", "-q", "-m", "init")
out = bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "S", "--goal", "g").stdout
m = re.search(r"new sprint (SP-[a-z0-9]{8})", out)
r = re.search(r"research story (ST-[a-z0-9]{8})", out)
if not (m and r):
    print("check broken: no sprint ids"); sys.exit(2)
sid, review = m.group(1), r.group(1)
bl("set", review, "--notes", "No outside facts: planted.")
bl("answer", sid, "start", "--answer", "approve", "--by", "operator"); bl("start", sid)
git("add", "-A"); git("commit", "-q", "-m", "start")
c = bl("claim", review, "--by", "claude-0000aaaa", "--commit")
state = lambda: json.loads(run(sys.executable, os.path.join(T, "coord.py"), "--store", S, "get", "run/" + review).stdout or "{}").get("value")
before = state()
d = bl("done", review)
after = state()
print("claim rc", c.returncode, "| run state before done", before, "| after done without --commit", after, "| done rc", d.returncode)
sys.exit(0 if before == "claimed" and after == "claimed" else 1)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath("_tools"))
import bl_land
root = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
env = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@e.x", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@e.x")
def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, check=True)
def commit(msg, name):
    path = os.path.join(root, "kb", "_querylog", name) if name.startswith("q") else os.path.join(root, name)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(name)
    git("add", "-A")
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", msg)
git("init", "-q", "-b", "main")
iid = "BG-aaaaaaaa"
for i in range(5):
    commit("auto before\n\nKB-Auto: querylog", f"qpre{i}.jsonl")
commit(f'chore(backlog): claim {iid} "t"\n\nKB-Work: {iid}', "other.txt")
for i in range(30):
    commit("auto after\n\nKB-Auto: querylog", f"qpost{i}.jsonl")
calls = []
real = subprocess.run
def counting(argv, *a, **k):
    if argv and argv[0] == "git":
        calls.append(argv[1])
    return real(argv, *a, **k)
subprocess.run = counting
found = bl_land.delivery_evidence(root, [iid], ["kb/_querylog/**"])
subprocess.run = real
print("deliveries", len(found), "git processes", len(calls), sorted(set(calls)))
sys.exit(0 if len(found) == 30 and len(calls) <= 8 else 1)

gates.question: How does done know a land runs it, and how does delivery_evidence cut its git calls?
options: in_land flag on land's Namespace, rev-list per bound
read the run key's land process record, merge-base per bound
gates.recommendation: in_land flag on land's Namespace, rev-list per bound
gates.reason: land's own done call passes it, no coord read; one git rev-list --ancestry-path per bound plus one rev-list for undelivered and one log of the store
gates.answer: in_land flag on land's Namespace, rev-list per bound

notes: 2026-11-09 review: (1) bl_land.py:712 moves claimed to landed in cmd_done, which land also calls from its worktree before the push and verify; with no claimed to landing move in the table a failed push leaves landed over an item not on main. (2) delivery_evidence (bl_land.py:52-95, 4fd10f8cb8) ran merge-base --is-ancestor per KB-Auto commit: 27.9 s for one bound in this clone with 2309 such commits; one rev-list BOUND..HEAD set per bound (or stopping at the first failing commit, since the log is newest first) removes it. (3) done without --commit moves the key while the done file is only written: the repro covers it. The worker adds a check for (2) that bounds the git processes delivery_evidence starts on a planted repo with 30 KB-Auto commits, and one for (1) that runs land on a worker-less item whose push fails and reads the key.
